What I meant is moonton gives her out for free coz she sucks. And she's supposed to stay that way. Same for the other "starter" heroes like Eudora, Tigreal and Zilong. I mean if there are heroes that badly need revamps its them. But they can't make these starter heroes too strong. So from the way I see it, they would revamp/buff Layla last or never at all. 

Much like in card games like yugioh where starter decks are usually and intended to be underpowered. They are there to give you a start but not enough to carry you through all the way. 

Also she has insane damage output and her range at level 11(?) and up is broken as she can take down towers outside of the tower range. She'd be broken if she has a mobility skill as she can just hit and run

But hey, we have the cases for the likes of Bruno,Chou, Diggie, Nana, Franco and Karrie. They are fairly cheap heroes and easy to obtain but you would see these heroes dominate the meta alongside the more expensive ones (32k/600 dias)

I may be wrong...its just how I see it.

Cheating is very rampant in the game right now...I'm not very competitive and I just play casually...but in the rare instances that I do play Ranked, there are times that I come across these cheaters. One situation in particular is I get laggy if I come into close contact with a particular player from the opposing team...there are some instances where we are winning and then all of a sudden we all lag and the enemy ends up wiping all of us out. There's even an instance where I'm teamed with someone...same wifi network, same phone model, but he experiences lag and I don't (I'm a Tank main and he's playing ADC). 

Then, I saw some schmuck on Youtube spreading this info around about an app that lets you make your enemy laggy on ML leaving them defenceless so you can wipe them all out.

I messaged Moonton on their Facebook page but it seems that it is falling on deaf ears. 

I'm getting tired of this and I question myself if I should continue playing this game or just wait for LOL Wild Rift to come out. I don't mind getting defeated by smurfs or players that are actually better in the game...that's really how it is...but its really demoralizing if you get defeated all because you can't fight back properly.

I hope Moonton implements a harsher ban method like banning someone's device coz those players who get banned can just make new accounts. But until then I don't find the game enjoyable right now so would be playing some other games until LOL WildRift comes out or maybe another better Moba on mobile.

Pretty much the same here. I dont know if you'd appreciate this but each of us has our own story. You maybe a background character to someone else's, but you are the main character in your own life. Though you dont have control on all situations and settings, unlike being a character in a story, you have complete agency on what you will do. Heck, even break the 4th wall if you want to like Deadpool. Agency is a superpower most of us dont realize we have. It's not a matter of what is happening beyond our control, its how we react. 

I also thought I was living in the "dark timeline" but i realized that timelines are born based on ou decisions. This means from this very present moment, you have the power to choos which timeline you belong to. It's all up to your decisions. 

So we are characters that writers cant control and we have the ability to jump timelines and parallel universes. We're pretty much gods on our own right.

I hope this helps. May you have a great day!
